Situation: Valproic acid 250 mg/5 mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 84 units with 12.8 days on hand at 6.6 units per day. Corvale General holds 139 units with 17.6 days on hand at 7.9 units per day. Corvale Lakeside holds 29 units with 13.9 days on hand at 2.1 units per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show valproic acid is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory across sites provides 12.8 to 17.6 days of supply. No FDA shortage exists. Procurement should secure additional stock from suppliers not on the shortage list to maintain buffer.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (ranked option 1) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Chartwell Governmental & Specialty RX, LLC (ranked option 2) — requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Chartwell RX, LLC (ranked option 3) — requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with Kesin Pharma Corporation (ranked option 4) — requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with NorthStar Rx LLC (ranked option 5) — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No allocation changes, formulary substitutions, or clinical restrictions at this time.
